trailer.title: The Funfair: official trailer
trailer.description: Coasters, carnival games, karts, a coaster builder and a flight to a tropical island: The Funfair, a free 3D theme park in your browser.
trailer.longDescription:
The Funfair is a free 3D theme park game that runs in your web browser, with nothing to download.

Drive the Thunder Loop coaster yourself, ride the 250 km/h Sky Falcon, race karts on the Turbo Speedway, build a coaster in the Coaster Workshop, then take the SkyLink to the airport and fly an A320neo 40 km south to the island of Palm Cay.

Everything in the trailer is real gameplay, filmed in the park.

getting-started.title: Getting started: walk, explore and start your first ride
getting-started.description: Walk in as a guest, learn to walk, run and roll, find your way with the map and fast travel, and start your first ride.
getting-started.longDescription:
New to The Funfair? This tutorial takes you from the gates to your first ride.

You'll walk in as a guest, move around with the keyboard or touch, turn the camera, open the map to fast travel, and step into a ride's glowing ring to play.
steps: Open The Funfair in your browser and walk in as a guest.
Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys, run with Shift and roll with Space. On touch, use the joystick.
Drag to turn the camera, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
Press M to open the map, pick a place and fast travel there. Press R to go back to the entrance.
Walk into a ride's glowing ring and press E to play.

tickets-and-account.title: Tickets and your account: free tickets, treats and souvenirs
tickets-and-account.description: Sign up free, collect 20 tickets every 5 hours, spend them on rides and games, and shop for treats and souvenirs at Rosa's booth.
tickets-and-account.longDescription:
Walking around The Funfair is free for everyone. Rides and games use tickets, and tickets come free with an account.

This tutorial shows how to sign up with Google or email, collect your free pack of 20 tickets every 5 hours, spend tickets on rides, and visit Rosa's booth for treats with perks and souvenirs you can wear. Nothing in the park costs real money today; paid extras are coming soon.
steps: Choose Sign up on the welcome card, with Google or with an email, a username and a password.
Collect your free pack of 20 tickets at the Ticket Booth. A new pack is ready every 5 hours.
Walk into a ride's ring and press E: most rides and games cost 1 ticket.
Visit Rosa's booth for treats with perks and souvenirs to wear.
Open your account to see your tickets, your rounds and your souvenirs.

thrill-rides.title: Thrill rides: drive the Thunder Loop and ride the Sky Falcon
thrill-rides.description: How to drive the Thunder Loop coaster, ride the 250 km/h Sky Falcon, and take on the Giant Wheel, Sky Flip, Nebula 360 and Rocket Ride.
thrill-rides.longDescription:
The Funfair's thrill rides, and the keys that make them yours.

Drive the Thunder Loop with power, brake and turbo through its loop and zero-g roll. Climb the Sky Falcon to the clifftop for a 158 m drop at 90° and a launch to 250 km/h. Then ride the 250 m Giant Wheel, swing over the top on the Sky Flip, hang upside down on Nebula 360 and fire the Rocket Ride's six stages.
steps: Thunder Loop: hold W for power, S to brake, Shift for turbo, and C to change the camera.
Sky Falcon: sit back for the climb, then switch cameras with E or C for the drop.
Giant Wheel: hold W to fast-forward the turn, and look around with A and D.
Sky Flip and Nebula 360: switch cameras with E or C, and press Esc to get off.
Rocket Ride: press E to fire each stage.

games-and-races.title: Games and races: from the Duck Shoot to the Jet-Ski Race
games-and-races.description: Win at the Duck Shoot, High Striker and Crate Smash, race the karts and the rally buggy, and play the four games on Palm Cay.
games-and-races.longDescription:
Every game in The Funfair, and how to score.

On the midway: the Duck Shoot, the High Striker and Crate Smash. On the tracks: three laps of the Turbo Speedway and the Rally Trail time trial, with your ghost and the daily top ten. On Palm Cay: the Jet-Ski Race, the Splash Tower, Pirate Cannons and Beach Volley.
steps: Duck Shoot: aim with W A S D or the mouse, and fire with E, Space or a click. Look out for the golden duck.
High Striker: press E or Space at the right moment on the meter.
Turbo Speedway: drive with W A S D, use Shift for nitro and Space to drift.
Rally Trail: beat your ghost through three checkpoints and climb the daily top ten.
On Palm Cay: race the jet-skis, pick a water slide, fire the cannons and serve at Beach Volley.

coaster-workshop.title: Build your own coaster in the Coaster Workshop
coaster-workshop.description: Build a coaster from parts, test-ride it for free and send it to the staff. Released coasters open in Creators' Valley.
coaster-workshop.longDescription:
The Coaster Workshop lets you design your own rollercoaster in The Funfair.

Start with your free starter kit, lay straights, curves, slopes, helixes, loops and corkscrews, and check that the circuit can be built. Test-ride it for free, then send it to the staff. Released coasters open on a plot in Creators' Valley, and you earn tickets each time someone rides yours.
steps: Go to the Coaster Workshop with a free account and open your free starter kit.
Add pieces: straights, curves, slopes, helixes, loops and corkscrews.
Fix any issues until the circuit can be built.
Test-ride your coaster for free.
Send it to the staff. If they release it, it opens in Creators' Valley.

fly-to-palm-cay.title: Fly the A320neo to Palm Cay
fly-to-palm-cay.description: Take the SkyLink to the airport, book Gate 3, then push back, take off and land the A320neo yourself on the island of Palm Cay.
fly-to-palm-cay.longDescription:
The Funfair doesn't end at the park gates.

Ride the SkyLink to Funfair International, book a flight at Gate 3 and choose dawn, day, dusk or night. Then take the captain's seat of the A320neo: push back, taxi, take off, cruise at 5,000 ft and land 40 km south on Palm Cay. ATC, the autopilot and your first officer help all the way, and optional assists can taxi and land for you.
steps: Take the SkyLink from the park's south gate to the airport.
Walk to Gate 3 and book the flight for 10 tickets. Pick a time of day and any assists.
Push back and taxi out, or let your first officer taxi for you.
Take off with full thrust (Y) and pull back with S, then raise the gear with G.
Cruise at 5,000 ft, use T for time warp, and land on Palm Cay.

your-look.title: Change your look in the changing room
your-look.description: Pick who you are, dye your clothes and hair, and adjust your height and build in the changing room beside Rosa's booth.
your-look.longDescription:
In The Funfair you choose who visits the park.

On your first visit, and any time later in the changing room beside Rosa's booth, pick a person from the cast, dye your top, bottoms, shoes and hair, and adjust your height and build. It's free and needs no account: guests' looks are saved in the browser, and members' looks are saved to their account.
steps: On your first visit, choose who's visiting today. Later, walk into the changing room beside Rosa's booth.
Pick a person.
Dye your top, bottoms, shoes and hair, from the palette or a colour of your own.
Adjust your height and build, or press Random for a surprise.
Press Done to walk back into the park.
